headline: Makeborne 90-day growth plan: sell Studio to freelancers and agencies with real-build short-form, a review-page loop and feature beats gated on quality. Plan on ~$174k ARR by 26 Jan 2027; $1M is a breakout scenario, not the plan.
summary: Spine: the creator-led engine (show the product working, Instagram keyword DMs to format-matched pages, small paid creator waves, boosts only for posts with a tracked sale, then revenue-funded Content Rewards at ~$1.60 per 1,000 views). Aimed at ICP 1 (freelancers and small agencies on Studio $49) with the agency loops (review-page referral link, 'play the client' sample review link, activation = review link sent). Calendar from the launch-events plan (six-box feature gate, Launch Week bundling, Product Hunt at the images beat, day-30 and day-90 public numbers). Four core surfaces at 25-30 posts a week; founder time is the binding constraint and support comes first. The $1,000 is one concentrated test behind a spend gate: no dollar before /go/ links, first touch and mb_src/mb_campaign/mb_aff on Makeborne-created Whop checkouts are live. Whop store or tracking links are never used: only Makeborne-created checkout links are used. Base case ~$14.5k MRR / ~$174k ARR at the day-90 review (25 Jan; calculator); if creator traffic converts like average traffic, ~$11.2k MRR / ~$134k ARR and paid CAC ~$103. Low ~$16k; high ~$565k; breakout ~$1.00M needs ~117k visits including loops at 1.6% visit-to-paid with no free tier, 3-5 product posts above 1M views and ~$5k revenue-funded Content Rewards over 90 days under D4.

Self-hunt from a week-old account; no upvote asks, swaps or paid hunters

risks.risk: Press frames Makeborne as a Lovable clone
risks.mitigation: Lead with outputs and client approval; generous comparisons; no 'better than' claims

risks.risk: Platform policy drift (music, originality, DM automation)
risks.mitigation: Commercial Music Library only; native re-edits; monthly re-check
No secrets, IDs, buyer or creator data or infrastructure details; cropped screenshots

risks.risk: Prices shown before tax in ads to EU and UK consumers (Price Indication Directive; UCPD Art. 7(4)(c)) [U]
risks.mitigation: Say 'From $20/month + tax where applicable' or show VAT-inclusive EU prices; legal check before paid EU/UK traffic

decisions.question: Keep 'full refund until you use credits' or switch to 'full refund within 7 days if under 100 credits used'?
decisions.recommendation: Switch after a legal check on EU digital-content withdrawal; adopt by the 16 Nov offer check at the latest (~$3 AI cost per refund)

decisions.question: Offer a capped first-build preview for /go/ traffic?
decisions.recommendation: Decide 16 Nov; turn on if /go/ visit-to-paid is under 0.7% or no source is at <=$50 CAC (~$0.90 per preview)

decisions.question: Affiliate and partner terms?
decisions.recommendation: 30% recurring 12 months for founding 20; 20% public; yearly first payment only; 30-day hold; clawback; Whop custom affiliates only

decisions.question: Revenue reinvestment rule?
decisions.recommendation: 30% of weekly net new cash into sources at or under target CAC; 10% when up to 25% above; 0% beyond

decisions.question: Black Friday offer?
decisions.recommendation: 'Yearly is 20% off' only; no extra discount

decisions.question: AI daily limit rule?
decisions.recommendation: Automatic rise tied to new paid accounts plus manual raise before every beat or creator post

decisions.question: What happens to client sites when a plan lapses?
decisions.recommendation: Keep them online with the badge forced on and a win-back offer

decisions.question: Review-page 'Review powered by Makeborne' link?
decisions.recommendation: On by default; removable on Studio and Scale when white label ships

decisions.question: Staffing: support cover and editing help?
Publish real numbers at day 30 and day 90?
Per-wave bonus codes?
decisions.recommendation: +100 credits on the first paid month per beat

decisions.question: Share-for-credits and customer referral amounts?
decisions.recommendation: 100 credits per disclosed share; +100 each side on a non-refunded first payment

decisions.question: Approve operating costs outside the $1,000?
decisions.recommendation: Yes: ~$180 demo builds, ~$160 comped creator credits

decisions.question: Allow comment-reply builds for real businesses?
decisions.recommendation: Yes with written consent, public information only, unpublished by default

decisions.question: Extra accounts (faceless, niche, language clone)?
decisions.recommendation: None before day 60; then only with an editor and a format with 3+ wins

decisions.question: Add a free tier?
decisions.recommendation: Keep none for now; revisit at the day-90 review with real data

decisions.question: Run a blind evaluation vs competitors?
Founder on camera and face of the press story?
